 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Bayer Leverkusen entertain Olympique de Marseille as they hope to return to winning ways before their weekend's derby against Köln. Carles Martinez's side are yet to concede a goal in Europe, while the visitors lost all three games. Argentine defender Facundo Medina will face his former club in tonight's clash.
 Confirmed Lineups
 Leverkusen: Flekken; Vazquez, Medina, Tapsoba ©, Quansah; Andrich, Garcia; Hofmann, Maza, Gutierrez; Schick
 OM: De Lange; Weah ©, Egan-Riley, Aguerd, Garcia; Hojbjerg, Abdelli, Kondogbia; Bezahaf, Gouiri, Paixao
